info.title: Select API
info.description: Workspace-scoped REST API generated from the Select schema. Authenticate with a user access token or an `slct_` API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData $filter expression. Combine conditions with `and`, `or`, `not`, and parentheses. Comparison: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `ge`, `lt`, `le`, `in`; string match: `contains(field,'x')`, `startswith(field,'x')`, `endswith(field,'x')`; null: `field eq null` / `field ne null`. See the endpoint description for the filterable fields and their types. Examples: group_id eq 'value' and role_id eq 'value'; (group_id eq 'value' or role_id eq 'value') and not (group_id eq 'value')

get.description:
Requires workspace action(s): audit.read.

**Filterable fields**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | Unique identifier of the event. _Operators: eq, ne, in, not in._ |
| `occurred_at` | date-time | When the event occurred (event time). _Operators: eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge, in, not in._ |
| `recorded_at` | date-time | When the event was recorded; may lag occurred_at. _Operators: eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge, in, not in._ |
| `domain` | string (query, auth, iam, datasource) | Domain of the action. _Operators: eq, ne, in, not in, contains, startswith, endswith._ |
| `action` | string | Action performed within its domain. See the [audit log reference](/workspace/audit-logs/) for the full list of actions. _Operators: eq, ne, in, not in, contains, startswith, endswith._ |
| `principal_id` | uuid | Identifier of the principal. _Operators: eq, ne, in, not in._ |
| `principal_type` | string (user, api_key) | Type of the principal that performed the action. _Operators: eq, ne, in, not in, contains, startswith, endswith._ |
| `target_type` | string (permission, role, user, datasource) | Type of the target the action was performed on. _Operators: eq, ne, in, not in, contains, startswith, endswith._ |
| `target_id` | uuid | Identifier of the target. _Operators: eq, ne, in, not in._ |
| `target_label` | string | Label of the target at the time of the event. _Operators: eq, ne, in, not in, contains, startswith, endswith._ |
| `status` | string (success, error, failure, denied) | Outcome of the action. _Operators: eq, ne, in, not in, contains, startswith, endswith._ |
| `payload` | json | Domain-specific details of the event. _Operators: contains._ |
| `client_ip` | ip | IP address of the client. _Operators: eq, ne, in, not in._ |

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData $filter expression. Combine conditions with `and`, `or`, `not`, and parentheses. Comparison: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `ge`, `lt`, `le`, `in`; string match: `contains(field,'x')`, `startswith(field,'x')`, `endswith(field,'x')`; null: `field eq null` / `field ne null`. See the endpoint description for the filterable fields and their types. Examples: recorded_at eq 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z and action eq 'value'; (recorded_at eq 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z or action eq 'value') and not (recorded_at eq 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)
